facts.summary: Protected files (README, inputs, contracts, checkers) are immutable; initial data is spec.
facts.quote: README.md、TASK.md、inputs/、contract.json、check_module.py、check.py、integrate.py以及适用的materialize.py、__init__.py、parser.py不可修改。初始输入和契约为任务规格，不是可以修正的错误数据。

facts.summary: Case input defines archive_prefix, download_prefix, month 2026-11, trash_keyword news, manager reply target m7.
materialize.py validates manifest hash and writes protected component stubs (model/transform/render).
Shell execution of materialize.py succeeded with MATERIALIZED output and generated component files.
files component implements download_archive: moves PNG/JPG/PDF from Downloads to Archive subdirs by extension.
mail component implements mail_trash: selects emails in month matching subject keyword, excluding TRASH folder.
facts.quote: 局部检查：`python3 products/mail/check_module.py`；先生成该契约所需输入及本组件输出，不跳过缺失依赖。

facts.summary: commit component implements workspace_commit: replays file moves, trashes emails, checks for reply/trash conflict.
final_report.py must output title, component_count, sha256 of core, and attention list based on result flags.
facts.quote: 实现final_report.py，读取完整core对象，写outputs/final_report.json，恰含title、component_count、sha256、attention。title准确为'下载目录归档、邮件清理与目标回复'，component_count为components键数。

facts.summary: check.py enforces outputs directory safety (no symlinks, parent must be ROOT) before running pipeline.
facts.quote: if out.is_symlink() or out.resolve().parent!=ROOT: raise ValueError('unsafe outputs')

facts.summary: integrate.py aggregates all contract outputs into core_manifest.json, skipping outputs dir contracts.
